title: The lamp's cord
logline: The green lamp's cord, close, taped in two places, running from the lamp's base off the table to the wall. Eleven years since it came home along 101. The page draws the tape.

panels.composition: Close on a green desk lamp's base and its cord running off a drafting table to a wall socket, the cord taped in two places with black tape, lamplight.
